text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since Inari One's debut race,
and while I was putting together a plan
for her upcoming race rotation—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Cut the crap, you blithering fool!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"......Ah.
I feel a little bit better now......"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss.
Didn't mean to startle ya.
I just didn't have anywhere else to yell...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Sis.
Didn't mean to startle ya.
I just didn't have anywhere else to yell...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...A few classmates came up to chat with me
about my debut race the other day—"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
—Inari!
I saw your debut race the other day!
You ran so amazingly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Much obliged!
But we're just getting started.
I'm gonna run even more wildly from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Inari-san...!
No wonder you were able to transfer in, you really have the skills.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Well, of course~! I knew right away that Inari's running was way too good to be kept in the local circuits!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Were you scouted by Trainer?
That makes you super lucky, you know.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...?
Inari, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... it's nothin', don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—My bad.
Got something on my mind I need to think over, so I'm gonna step out for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for comin' out to watch my debut race!
See ya around!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Wait, hey, Inari~?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...And that's basically what happened, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "...If I'd stayed and kept listening, I would've lost my temper for sure. That's why I came over here."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Boss, hearing that just now,
don't you think something's fishy?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis, hearing all that just now, don't you think something's fishy?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why does everyone talk like I 'moved up' from regional to the Central League?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why does everyone...
treat the local circuits like they're inferior trash?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I can't stand this.
I don't accept this, not one damn bit...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The regionals... the bosses...! 
The place where I was raised!
Is by no means inferior to the Central!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
......But, y'know.
Since transferring here up till today,
there's something I've come to understand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's true that the Central races are huge.
The scale, the crowd size—they're all bigger than in the regional circuits. That's a fact. I ain't denying that.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What the guys in class are saying just boils down to that "difference in scale."
I know they don't mean any harm by it, either.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: However, even so—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The power, the passion, the fighting spirit of everyone running in the regionals!
I'll never let anyone say
that we're inferior to the Central!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
............
I really don't wanna have to say it, but――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even if someone fresh off their debut like me said anything,
no one would listen anyway.
I understand that much all too well.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "...So, I've made up my mind."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In this Twinkle Series, I'm gonna become
a presence way, way bigger than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll stack up huge achievements, one after another,
so I can become someone so big that nobody can ignore what I have to say—in other words!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A massive firework everyone has to look up to!
A noisy firework that makes everyone turn around!
All I gotta do is become that kind of firework, and that's that!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—How's that, eh?
Starting today, this is Lady Inari's brand-new goal!
choice_data_list: That's the best goal you could ask for!
That's a fantastic goal to aim for!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right?
Boss really is so quick to understand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right?
Sis really is so quick to understand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Our goal is the grandest stage! The greatest festival!
Where I'll show everyone that Inari One is right here!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oi! The NAR! Ain't inferior to the JRA one bit,
and I'm gonna declare it loud and proud!!

And so, a major new goal
was born for Inari One...!
Afterward, when it was time for training...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So, Boss.
What do you think I should do next
if I wanna set off fireworks at a huge festival?
choice_data_list: Let's steadily build up your strength and gain experience

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So, Sis.
What do you think I should do next
if I wanna set off fireworks at a huge festival?
choice_data_list: Let's steadily build up your strength and gain experience

text_block_list.text: In the Junior Class, one shouldn't rush for results. Rather than fixating on a specific race, prioritizing physical conditioning and refining technique is the way to go.

On top of that, I want her to gain a fair amount of actual race experience in the JRA
to prepare her so she can challenge greater heights in the upcoming Classic Class...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—I see, I see!
Even when throwing a big festival,
thorough preparation beforehand is essential, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So to speak, we've changed from the 'Great Inari Brawling Tour' to a 'Warrior's Training Journey'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now that that's settled,
let's get right down to training!
"Aiming toward a massive future goal, a fiery trial of training in the Junior Class was about to begin...!"
